name: West Virginia

agency.name: West Virginia Division of Labor, Wage and Hour Section

rates2026.area: Employers with 6 or more employees at one location
rates2026.note: Rate unchanged since January 1, 2016; also applies to state agencies

minWage.headlineArea: Employers with 6 or more employees at one location
minWage.smallEmployer: The state minimum wage law covers only employers with six or more employees in one separate, distinct and permanent location; smaller employers are subject only to the federal $7.25 if covered by the FLSA.

tipped.note: Tip credit of 70% of the minimum wage ($6.13); cash wage $2.62 per the U.S. DOL tipped table

minWage.other: Training wage: $6.40 per hour for new employees under 20, for up to 90 days.

source.quote: After December 31, 2015, every employer shall pay to each of his or her employees wages at a rate not less than $8.75 per hour.

overtime.note: Time and a half after 40 hours a week. For the overtime rule, employers are excluded if 80% of their employees are covered by the federal overtime law (FLSA then applies).

source.quote: no employer shall employ any of his employees for a workweek longer than forty hours, unless such employee receives compensation ... not less than one and one-half times the regular rate

sickLeave.note: No statewide paid sick leave law for private employers.

finalPay.fired: on or before the next regular payday
finalPay.quit: on or before the next regular payday
finalPay.ptoNote: Accrued fringe benefits (such as vacation) capable of calculation count as wages, but are calculated according to the employer-employee agreement; benefits payable later or on conditions under the agreement follow that agreement.

source.quote: the person, firm or corporation shall pay the employee's wages due for work that the employee performed prior to the separation of employment on or before the next regular payday

ptoSource.quote: the term "wages" shall also include then accrued fringe benefits capable of calculation and payable directly to an employee

breaks.meal: at least 20 minutes for meal breaks in a workday of 6 or more hours, when employees are not otherwise given breaks or allowed to eat while working

source.quote: During the course of a workday of six or more hours, all employers shall make available for each of their employees, at least twenty minutes for meal breaks

rightToWorkSource.quote: A person may not be required, as a condition or continuation of employment, to: (1) Become or remain a member of a labor organization

notes.text: The state minimum wage ($8.75) applies only where an employer has six or more employees at one location.

source.quote: who employs during any calendar week six or more employees as herein defined in any one separate, distinct, and permanent location or business establishment

notes.text: Fired and resigning employees have the same deadline: wages are due by the next regular payday.

source.quote: Whenever a person, firm, or corporation discharges an employee, or whenever an employee quits or resigns from employment ... on or before the next regular payday

uncertain: Tipped cash wage $2.62 from the U.S. DOL tipped table; the statute gives a 70% credit (30% of $8.75 = $2.625).
